changes: Class Colors is now the default across all addons. Explicit saved theme choices are kept, and the other themes remain available.
Highground battleground rows stay in place while ranks and recommendations update. Enable optional priority sorting with `/hg config behavior` → Reorder enemy rows by priority (out of combat).
The Highground suggested-target card starts off. Enable it with `/hg config appearance` → Panels → Suggested target card. Hiding it keeps recommendations active.
notice: From the previous release, /reload is enough. Restart WoW if your installed version predates Class Colors. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
